name: Send Text Using Template
description: Send a text message using a pre-defined template. Variables can be sent only as text. [See the docs.](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/reference/messages#message-templates)

configurable_props.name: phoneNumberId
configurable_props.label: Phone Number ID
configurable_props.description: Phone number ID that will be used to send the message.

configurable_props.name: recipientPhoneNumber
configurable_props.label: Recipient Phone Number
configurable_props.description: Enter the recipient's phone number. For example, `15101234567`.

configurable_props.name: messageTemplate
configurable_props.label: Message Template
configurable_props.description: Select the template you'd like to use.

configurable_props.name: headerVars
configurable_props.label: Header Variables
configurable_props.description: Array of header variables for programmatic/AI-agent use. Takes precedence over individual header props if provided.

configurable_props.name: bodyVars
configurable_props.label: Body Variables
configurable_props.description: Array of body variables for programmatic/AI-agent use. Takes precedence over individual body props if provided.

configurable_props.name: buttonVars
configurable_props.label: Button Variables
configurable_props.description: Array of button variables for programmatic/AI-agent use. Takes precedence over individual button props if provided.
